notes: Most SUVs are recorded here and cannot be told apart from station wagons. CLASS MC (off-road passenger) is 24% of this body, but its share of new passenger vehicles fell from about 20% to 12% over the years SUV sales rose, so it is not an SUV proxy.
Passenger vans and people movers (Hiace, iMax, Serena, Alphard).
Mostly utes registered as passenger vehicles; also a few small off-roaders (Jimny, Land Cruiser).
Three-wheelers registered as passenger vehicles (class LE): Can-Am Spyder and Ryker, Yamaha MW, Piaggio MP3.
Full-size pickups over 3500 kg GVM (RAM 2500, Silverado HD, F-250).
Mostly large vans (Transit, Sprinter, Daily); also some box-bodied light trucks (Dyna, Dutro) that the body code cannot separate.
Heavy regardless of GVM: the 45 rows recording 3500 kg or less are implausible for this body.
Goods-rated wagons and vans (Defender, Hiace, Estima, NV200, Corolla wagon). Too mixed to call.
